name: Axelar
notes: Cross-chain bridge, predominantly Cosmos/IBC with a custom validator network; activity tracked via Axelarscan, not an EVM subgraph. No public The Graph/Ponder-style indexer repo found.

name: Extended
notes: Starknet-based perps DEX (x10xchange org). Off-chain orderbook with Starknet settlement; org publishes SDKs and Cairo perpetual contracts but no public subgraph/indexer repo (WebFetched org listing).

name: Lagoon
notes: hopperlabsxyz org has lagoon-v0 contracts, SDK, MCP and vault-computation-cli but no public subgraph/indexer repo (WebFetched org repos). Docs reference 'Vault Subgraphs' but the integration page returns 403 and no repo is published; vault data appears served via SDK/CLI rather than an open indexer.

name: exSat Staking BTC
notes: Bitcoin staking/bridge (exSat / EOS-VM). Custodial BTC staking, non-EVM; no public subgraph/indexer.

name: CoinDCX
notes: Centralized exchange. TVL is custodial wallet balances; no on-chain protocol to index.

name: Sanctum Infinity
notes: Solana-only LST liquidity pool (INF). Non-EVM; indexed via Solana-specific tooling, no EVM-style subgraph/indexer repo found.

name: Telos Consilium
notes: Risk curator deploying capital into existing lending markets (Plasma/Ethereum). Curator entity rather than its own indexable protocol; no public indexer repo found.

name: Kamino Liquidity
notes: Solana-only concentrated liquidity manager. Non-EVM; no public EVM-style subgraph/indexer repo.

name: Dolomite

repos.scope: Full protocol: Dolomite Margin contracts, markets, lending/margin positions, liquidations, vaporizations, account health, USD/historical stats; deployed per-chain (Arbitrum, Berachain, Mantle, etc.)
repos.verified: WebFetched repo page: contains schema.graphql + subgraph.template.yaml, 453 commits, 100% TypeScript, explicitly tracks Dolomite Margin contract state, markets, liquidations, account health. Official dolomite-exchange org repo; docs.dolomite.io documents per-chain subgraph endpoints.

notes: Official subgraph maintained by dolomite-exchange. Forked originally from the Uniswap subgraph.

name: Clearstar
notes: Risk curator (ClearstarLabs) allocating into lending markets across many chains. Curator entity, no own protocol contracts to index; no public indexer repo found.

name: Sky Money
notes: This DefiLlama entry is Sky's curated vaults (third-party Morpho strategies facilitated via sky.money). sky-ecosystem org has no subgraph repo (org search returned 0 matches). Community Maker MCD subgraph (protofire/maker-protocol-subgraph) exists but indexes legacy MCD CDPs, not the Sky-curated Morpho vaults; not a scope match for this specific entry.

name: Biconomy.com
notes: Centralized exchange (distinct from Biconomy account-abstraction infra). Custodial balances; no on-chain protocol to index.

name: GAIB
notes: AID/sAID AI-compute RWA synthetic dollar (LayerZero OFT tokens on ETH/Arbitrum/Base/BNB). gaib-ai org (WebFetched) holds only DefiLlama adapter forks and tooling; no public subgraph/indexer repo.

name: NAVI Lending

repos.scope: Sui only: NAVI lending_core processor (sui/navi) indexing supply/borrow/deposit/liquidation events and pools across NAVI package addresses on Sui mainnet (project navi/navi-production-new)
repos.verified: git clone: sui/navi/sentio.yaml targets sui_mainnet with four NAVI package addresses (incl. navi_multi_market); src maps Supply/Borrow/Deposit/liquidation/Pool. Last commit 2026-05-11. Official naviprotocol org (Sentio-based indexer).

notes: NAVI is Sui (Move), not EVM, so no The Graph subgraph; instead an official Sentio indexer in naviprotocol/sentio-processors. Org also has navi-sdk and contracts.

name: Liquity V1

repos.scope: Liquity V1 Ethereum mainnet: TroveManager, BorrowerOperations, StabilityPool, CollSurplusPool, PriceFeed, LQTYStaking, LUSDToken, LQTYToken
repos.verified: WebFetched subgraph.yaml.js: network mainnet, dataSources enumerate all V1 core contracts (TroveManager/BorrowerOperations/StabilityPool/etc). Official liquity/dev V1 monorepo (V2 lives in liquity/bold). V1 contracts immutable so subgraph is feature-complete though low-churn.

notes: Official subgraph in the liquity/dev V1 monorepo (packages/subgraph). Confirmed indexing of all V1 troves/stability-pool/staking contracts on Ethereum mainnet.

name: EtherFi Cash Liquid
notes: ether.fi Cash product (cash-v3 / cash-contracts on Optimism/Scroll). etherfi-protocol org (WebFetched) has contracts but no public subgraph/indexer repo. Search claim of a 'deployed subgraph' was not backed by any repository.

name: Blend Pools V2
notes: Stellar/Soroban lending protocol (blend-capital org: blend-contracts-v2, blend-contract-sdk in Rust). Non-EVM; no public subgraph or open indexer repo (Stellar indexing would use SubQuery/custom, none published by the team).

name: Yield Basis
notes: Curve-ecosystem leveraged BTC liquidity (yield-basis/yb-core, autoleverage AMM). Org publishes contracts only; no public subgraph/indexer repo found.

name: Aster asBNB
notes: Aster Earn BNB liquid-staking derivative (asBNB) on BNB Chain. Aster's only public indexer (asterdexcom/cloud-perp-subgraph) covers the apx perpetual contracts, NOT the asBNB Earn product; no indexer scoped to this entry.

name: Tectonic
notes: Compound-fork money market on Cronos. tectonicfi GitHub org has no public repositories (WebFetched); no public subgraph/indexer repo found despite being EVM lending.

name: Fluid Lite
notes: Instadapp Fluid 'Lite' vaults on Ethereum. Instadapp org publishes fluid-contracts-public but no Fluid subgraph/indexer (only legacy instadapp-dsa-subgraph for DeFi Smart Accounts, unrelated to Fluid Lite vaults).

name: Aave V4
notes: Aave V4 not yet generally deployed. Official aave/protocol-subgraphs covers V2/V3 (incl. GHO) but has no V4 datasources at this time; no V4-specific indexer published.

name: Aster USDF
notes: Aster Earn yield-dollar (USDF) on BNB Chain. Aster's only public indexer (asterdexcom/cloud-perp-subgraph) is scoped to apx perpetual trading, not the USDF Earn product; no indexer for this entry.

name: Theo Network thBill
notes: Theo runs hosted vault subgraphs on The Graph (theo-arb-eth-vault, theo-base-eth-vault decentralized-network endpoints) but no public source repository was found; vaults are powered by Concrete (Blueprint Finance). Hosted endpoint exists, open repo does not -> has_public_indexer=false (no public repo to verify against).

name: Aerodrome V1

repos.scope: Aerodrome (Base, chain 8453) + Velodrome V2 (Optimism): pools, gauges, voting/veNFT, swaps, liquidity (Envio HyperIndex)
repos.verified: WebFetched repo: README states 'multi-chain blockchain indexer for Velodrome V2 (Optimism) and Aerodrome (Base)', Base 8453 in supported networks, Envio config. Official velodrome-finance org repo shared with Aerodrome (same team/codebase).

notes: Indexed via the official Envio indexer velodrome-finance/indexer (Velodrome and Aerodrome share team/codebase). The aerodrome-finance org itself has only contracts/slipstream/sugar (sugar is an on-chain read API, not an indexer); no separate The Graph subgraph. Envio docs also publish an Aerodrome DEX indexer example.
